additions.note: Broad release of the frontier engineering, research, and cybersecurity model after the October 28 Fairwind rollout. Available via the Gemini API for paying developers and in Gemini for business, with a rollout to eligible Gemini app subscribers.
Vision-language-action model for dexterous manipulation across robot platforms, with improved physical safety controls. Google DeepMind is rolling it out to robotics partners.
Downloadable image generation and editing model with multi-reference input. MiniMax published the checkpoint under its H3-Image model license. The bundle includes a separate prompt enhancer.
Hosted agent model based on GLM-5.3-Flash for computer use and coding. Accepts text and images, supports tool calling, and has a 262K context window.

Shared model with improvements in reasoning, coding, and vision. Fable is broadly available with stricter cybersecurity and biology safeguards. Mythos has restricted access for verified organizations.
Small hosted model for high-volume agent work, including tool calls, routing, extraction, and coding subtasks. Available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code.
Hosted image-generation and editing model with native RGBA output and improved preservation of unchanged regions across repeated edits.
Technical validation model further trained from K-EXAONE 2.0 for coding and agent workflows. LG AI Research opened access through the EXAONE API Platform.

Japanese full-duplex speech model designed to handle interruptions and conversational backchannels. The research announcement describes evaluations and demos. API access and downloadable weights were not established.
Apache-2.0 post-train of Qwen3.8-27B designed to reduce state-aligned framing in responses to political questions.
Open-weight Korean and English decision model for text and images. Returns probabilities over typed answer options. Weights use the Kanana Open License.
Mistral marks its hosted multimodal flagship generally available as mistral-large-4, after the October 6 API preview and October 29 weight release.

Four smaller open-weight decision models extend the earlier 27B GLiDE. The models return probabilities over typed answer options through the same System One interface. Dated by the public family announcement.
Hosted MiniMax H3 derivative that replaces up to two people using reference photos while retaining the original scene, timing, and audio.

Embodied visual reasoning family led by Lion-ER-35B-A3B, a mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active parameters. The release includes smaller 4B and 9B models. November 4 records the public announcement following October repository uploads.
Real-time and asynchronous speech recognition models. The API can use the voice agent’s outgoing text as context and filter its speech from the user’s transcript.

Multimodal driving world model for closed-loop simulation with interactive traffic agents and simulated camera and lidar observations. Baidu unveiled it at its Apollo AI Day while using it internally for autonomous driving tests.
Production hosted release of the natively multimodal model for long-running agents and visual coding, following the September 25 preview. The platform changelog dates API availability to November 2.
Hosted audio decision model that returns probabilities over supplied answer choices about an audio clip, including non-speech cues.

Text-to-sound model with seamless looping and improved handling of compound prompts. Available to every workspace and through the API as eleven_text_to_sound_v3. This milestone follows the October 29 introduction.
SenseTime’s hosted multimodal model for office automation, sustained agent workflows, and design generation. Available in SenseNova Studio and via SenseNova Token Plan.
Open-weight speech recognition checkpoint for Hindi and Hindi-English speech. Maya Research released the BF16 weights under Apache-2.0.

additions.model: Eleven Realtime v1 Mini / Max (general availability)
additions.note: Hosted real-time voice models for conversational agents. ElevenLabs completed the rollout to every workspace after introducing the models on October 19.

Downloadable 27B decision model that accepts text, JSON, and images and returns probabilities over supplied choices. Weights use the Nace.AI Open RAIL-M license. The public weights followed an October 19 hosted launch.
Hosted tutoring model designed to guide learners with questions and hints. Available through the humans& Agents API as ampersand-tutor-v0.1.
Apache-2.0 streaming speech synthesis checkpoint for 11 Indian languages and English, with 20 built-in voices and zero-shot voice cloning.
Hosted GLM 5.3 post-train for group collaboration. The model can contribute a message, request a tool, or wait. It launched through the humans& Agents API.

before.note: Frontier model for long-horizon engineering, coding and cybersecurity. Google is initially rolling it out to selected cyber defenders and trusted Fairwind partners; broader product and developer access is forthcoming.

after.note: Frontier model for long-horizon engineering, coding, and cybersecurity. Initially rolled out to selected cyber defenders and trusted partners through Fairwind. Google opened wider developer and product access on November 10.
